location.disclosure: Sport Talent uses your location to show nearby games and courts and to confirm your check-in when you tap Check in at a game. Location is used only while you use the app. You can search by city instead.

cancel.cardIssued: Your spot is cancelled. This late cancel gave you a yellow card.
cancel.lateRecorded: Your spot is cancelled. Because it was late, you may get a yellow card after the game, unless someone from the waitlist takes your spot.

deposit.saved: Payment method saved. The hold is placed the day before the game.

details.playersAfterJoin: You’ll see who’s playing once the host approves you.

offer.body: You’re next on the waitlist. Accept the spot to join the game.
offer.flash: The game starts soon, so everyone on the waitlist got this offer. The first to accept gets the spot.

invite.signedOutBody: Sign in or create an account to see this game and join it.

teams.notLocked: The host hasn’t set the teams yet.

notifications.deviceNote: These choices are saved on this device.
notifications.unavailable: Push notifications aren’t available here. You’ll still see updates in your Inbox.

data.title: Your data
data.contact: Contact us and we’ll send you a copy.

delete.confirmIntro: This is the last step. Your account will be deleted right away and you’ll be signed out.
delete.games: You’ll be removed from games you’ve joined, with no yellow card, and any deposit holds are released. Games you host that haven’t started are handed to a co-host if there is one. Otherwise they’re cancelled and the players are told.
delete.keptMore: Payment records are kept in a form that doesn’t identify you for up to 7 years, because tax law requires it. Backups clear out within 30 days.
delete.timing: Your profile disappears from the app straight away. The rest of your personal data is erased within 24 hours.
delete.reregister: You can sign up again later with the same number. If a ban or warning is still running, the rest of it applies again.

dispute.windowLeft: You can dispute this card until {date} ({duration} left).
